# Sealbreaker

Type: Misc | Internal ID: DvergrKey | Source: Galdr table | Usage: Key | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Sealbreaker fragment x9

# Introduction

Sealbreaker is an item, constructed on the Galdr table from nine Sealbreaker fragments. It is a key to the entrance of The Queen. It is not consumed on use.

Categorias: Misc Items, Forsaken offerings
